title: DR1 names the CPH question "Add the county parish holding number (CPH)" in sentence case; the frontend title-cases it and names it two different ways on two pages.

finding.frontend: The consignment addresses page calls the row "County Parish Holding number (CPH)" and hints "The County Parish Holding (CPH) number identifies the holding where the animals will be kept." The page it leads to calls the same thing "County Parish Holding (CPH)" — the abbreviation has moved and the word "number" has gone. Both come from src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:9-12 and src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/cph-number/copy/copy.en.js:2-5, and both capitalise County Parish Holding as though it were a proper noun.
finding.prototype: DR1 uses sentence case throughout and puts the abbreviation last. The consignment addresses section is headed "County parish holding (CPH) number" and hinted "The county parish holding (CPH) number identifies the holding where the animals will be kept"; the page itself is headed "Add the county parish holding number (CPH)" (app/data/consignment-address-sections.js:69-75, app/views/cph-number.html:33). The field inside it is legended "CPH number".
finding.difference: Move the frontend to DR1's wording and casing: sentence case, the abbreviation in brackets, and the same name on the consignment addresses row as on the page it opens. The hub row and the page label are separate copy entries today, which is how they drifted apart, so fix both together and cover the pair in the copy test.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding the frontend consignment addresses row and the frontend CPH page heading already reading the same words as each other.
finding.verification: Read both rendered DOMs for fe-addresses-hub and fe-cph-number and for dr1-roles-and-addresses and dr1-cph-number, the fe-addresses-hub and dr1-cph-number screenshots, and both copy sources at the cited lines; ran the falsifier by comparing the two frontend strings directly. It does not fire — the hub row renders "County Parish Holding number (CPH)" and the page it opens renders "County Parish Holding (CPH)", which are different strings held in different copy files. DR1's three strings are as quoted, including the legend "CPH number" inside the page. CORRECT.

relatedTo.why: the label being changed sits on the same field the three-part input replaces
